claims: Artemis II is carrying four astronauts.
Artemis II's mission is to fly around the Moon and return to Earth.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
The crew will test the Orion spacecraft's systems in deep space.
The crew will swing around the far side of the Moon.
The crew will splash down in the Pacific Ocean.
The destination of Artemis II is a lunar flyby orbiting the Moon rather than landing.
The duration of Artemis II is approximately 10 days.
The crew of Artemis II consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The trajectory of Artemis II includes a high-speed return.
Artemis II involves testing the spacecraft's life support systems.
The crew of Artemis II is expected to travel farther into space than any human in history.
The crew of Artemis II is potentially surpassing the distance record set by Apollo 13.
Artemis II is designed to verify that the Orion capsule and Space Launch System (SLS) rocket can safely transport humans to deep space and return them to Earth.
